name: Can real hardwood flooring be installed in a basement?

mainEntity.name: Can real hardwood flooring be installed in a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Solid hardwood is not recommended for basement installations due to high relative humidity and concrete moisture. Solid wood expands and contracts significantly with humidity changes, leading to buckling and warping below ground level. If you want genuine wood warmth, engineered hardwood designed for below-grade use is a better alternative because its cross-layered core resists movement. Even so, engineered wood still requires strict slab moisture testing and vapor barriers, whereas luxury vinyl plank mimics wood without moisture vulnerability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Solid hardwood should not go below grade due to warping risks. Engineered hardwood or wood-look vinyl plank are much safer, stable basement alternatives.
